name: Escape from Slumberland
summary:
Can you escape your worst nightmares?

Escape from Slumberland is an online co-op horror game with up to 4 players. Dodge deadly traps, outwit fiendish monsters, and escape with enough moonbeams to sate an ancient evil’s hunger.

Play as Victorian children delving into hand-drawn dreamscapes and try to survive the nefarious experiments conducted by The Slumberland Institute. Gather toys from the dream realm and grind them into moonbeams while being hunted by your worst nightmares. Will you chicken out while you’re ahead or venture deeper for secrets that could multiply your haul?

Murdered by a shadowy beast? Do not despair! Death is not the end in the dream world. Help your friends from beyond the grave by bestowing powerful blessings and providing important information that could be the difference between certain doom and a miraculous escape.

Befriend the dream dwellers and gain powerful upgrades to help you overcome ever increasing difficulties. Uncover the mysteries of each dream to unlock new worlds to explore, each with their own set of enemies, puzzles, and rewards. But beware, the evil Slumberland Institute will sacrifice anything to control the dream realm, including you! Face your nightmares, uncover the truth, and see if you can truly Escape from Slumberland!
